title: Vanilla STD
description:
Optimisation and nice pack of vanilla for default servers and games. 

Updates every release
body:
Modpack for standard servers or single player. Added optimization and minor improvements to visuals and animations.

Vanilla STD is optimized to ensure smooth, responsive gameplay on systems with 2 to 3.5 GB of RAM recommended. This fine-tuning allows you to enjoy the modpack's enhancements without compromising on performance, making it accessible to a wide audience.

**Modpack is updated for the latest current version of Minecraft**

Features:
- Shaders
- New Animation
- Optimization
- New decorations
- New particles
